description: A walkable, 58-room New England harbor town built on FeltOS, carried live by QwzSpace, and rendered as a calm TUFTE interface. Exits, neighbors, evidence, weather, and exact-name commands all come from the same persistent world.

entryPoints.headless: POST /connect, POST /command, POST /tick, GET /events?actor=, GET /metrics (JSON-over-HTTP), plus QwzSpace WebSocket at /

statusNote: The harbor sleeps between visits and catches up in bounded steps on requests; every settled mutation is flushed to persistent storage.
